title.en: Check words against an actual choice

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构社团海报把三人的合写误标成你独立完成。你可以更正署名，既准确说出自己负责哪段，也不必把全部贡献推给别人。说“我只做了一点”并不自动完成公平归属；喜欢海报的漂亮装帧，也不说明是否会更正记录。这里将谦逊表达、实际署名与审美偏好分开。一次更正只是可观察事件，不验证整个诚实—谦逊领域，更不是要求别人信任你的证书。若只是阅读例子，不需联系任何人或公开过往。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented club poster credits you alone for three people’s writing. Correcting attribution can name your actual part without disclaiming it. Saying you did very little does not itself allocate credit fairly, and liking an attractive cover says nothing about correcting the record. Separate modest wording, attribution and taste. One correction is an observable event, not verification of the whole Honesty–Humility domain or a certificate requiring trust. Reading alone requires neither contact nor disclosure of past conduct.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“哪一项是已经发生的贡献，哪一项是自我描述，哪一项仍不知道？”用编造署名写一次准确说明，不测试朋友是否诚实、不要求认错，不按领域均分决定谁值得信任。没有个人分数时，仍可讨论这段通用例子。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “What contribution is observed, what is a self-description, and what remains unknown?” Draft an accurate fictional credit without honesty tests or compelled admissions. Domain means decide no trustworthiness, and this general example remains available without a personal score.

paragraphs.zh: 这些是原创通用例子，不是对你、朋友或真实事件的判断。六领域40条各自计分，不相加、不跨域排名、不按最高值派型，也不能转换为MBTI或大五分数；本版不另报24个个人侧面分数。任一NA保留该领域个人原始和与均分不足，但全文仍可读，不用别域补分。网页复制仅含测试标题、通用自我观察标签及公开入口链接，不带回答、均分或个人画像；也可自行分享本指南，分享并非必须。可以只读、私下写草稿或结束，无需让别人作答、证明身份或接受诊断。

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构桌游第一次采用陌生规则，一人反复担心自己弄错，却能认真跟完回合；另一人不太担心，却想先要一张提示卡。担忧多少、是否求助和实际完成怎样是不同观察，不能用某一次表现反推领域均分。愿意问规则不证明依赖更多，不问也不证明勇敢；可得提示、熟悉程度和当下状态都需要另行说明。这个低风险例子不用于推断焦虑疾病、治疗需要或危险中的能力，也不要求现实中接触让自己害怕的事。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented game introduces unfamiliar rules. One person worries about mistakes yet follows a round; another worries little but requests a cue card. Worry, asking for help and task performance are separate observations, and one performance cannot reconstruct a domain mean. Asking establishes no greater dependence; not asking proves no courage. Available cues, familiarity and current circumstances need their own description. This low-stakes illustration assesses neither anxiety disorders, treatment needs nor ability in danger and requires no feared real-life exposure.

title.zh: 说清一个有用的支持请求

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“这次需要的是规则信息、陪伴，还是暂不参加？”只比较虚构请求，不索取担忧经历、不评谁更坚强。可以少说、不分享或结束；领域的畏惧、担忧、求助与情感联结也不能合成一个健康分。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Is the wish for information, company or not joining now?” Compare invented requests without soliciting worries or ranking strength. Silence, privacy and stopping remain options; fear, worry, support-seeking and sentimental connection form no health score.

title.zh: 命名前先比较两个场景

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构故事会中，一人愿意与熟友聊很久，却不愿站到台前介绍；另一人能作一分钟开场，之后想独自整理材料。社交意愿、公开表达与事后精力并不必同向，这两段也不能代替40条一般符合度回答。安静整理可以是当时选择，不证明固定内向身份；台前说话也不证明社交技巧或领导有效。本领域的X是HEXACO标记，不是将MBTI某个偏好换字母；不同测评的同名内容与数字不可直接互换。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, someone enjoys a long conversation with familiar friends but declines a public introduction. Another gives a one-minute opening and then wants to sort materials alone. Sociability, public expression and later energy need not align; these episodes do not replace forty general-accuracy ratings. Quiet work establishes no fixed introvert identity, and speaking proves neither social skill nor effective leadership. X is this HEXACO domain’s label, not a relabelled MBTI preference; similarly named constructs and numbers are not interchangeable.

title.zh: 选一个合适的社交小实验

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“你愿意哪种参与方式，什么时候想休息？”给虚构邀请留公开发言、文字参与和不参加的选择，不按热闹程度评分，也不要求朋友猜你的类型。只分享公开指南即可，个人精力与均分不必公开。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “What participation is welcome, and when would a break help?” Offer fictional spoken, written and nonparticipation options without ranking animation or asking friends to guess a type. A public guide can be shared without personal energy reports or means.

title.en: A boundary can be patient and firm

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构画册里两人对标题有不同意见。可以说“我听懂你想突出地点，但我仍想保留人物名”，或先停止当前讨论；不必为了显得温和就同意改标题。语气克制、是否愿意考虑建议、是否仍生气和后来是否原谅是不同问题；明确拒绝一项改动不能自动证明耐心低。例子只比较一段可修改的文字，不评谁善良、谁应先道歉，也不把宽恕当作恢复信任或继续接触的条件。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two fictional readers disagree on a booklet title. One can acknowledge the wish to foreground a place while still preferring the character’s name, or stop the discussion. Gentleness requires no agreement. Tone, considering a suggestion, anger and later forgiveness are different questions; refusing a revision does not automatically establish low patience. This example concerns revisable text rather than kindness, apology order or an obligation to restore trust or contact.

title.zh: 练习一个可以修复的回应

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“理解了哪部分，仍不同意什么，是否愿意继续谈？”只改编造标题，不练真实冲突，不要求原谅或妥协。较高均分不授予调停能力，较低均分也不为侮辱、报复或伤害免责。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “What is understood, what remains disputed, and is further discussion wanted?” Revise a fictional title without rehearsing a real conflict or requiring forgiveness or compromise. Higher means confer no mediation skill; lower means excuse neither insults, retaliation nor harm.

title.en: Check the task and the resources

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构活动地图原定周日交稿，后来场地改了，旧版检查清单已不适用。有人桌面整齐却继续精修旧图，另一人纸张散乱但先确认新入口。条理、投入、细节与判断后果是不同线索，任务是否完成还要看新目标和可用资源。改计划不自动表示不尽责，检查更多也不自动更有效；应先确认这轮需要的版本，而不是用领域名决定谁负责全程。这个例子不测就业能力，也不把进度慢解释成懒惰。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional event map has a Sunday deadline but a changed venue makes the old checklist obsolete. Someone with a tidy desk keeps polishing the old map; someone with scattered papers first confirms the new entrance. Order, effort, detail and consequences are different clues. Completion also depends on the new goal and resources. Revising a plan implies no lack of conscientiousness, and more checking guarantees no benefit. Confirm the needed version rather than appoint an organiser by domain name. The example measures no employability and makes slow progress no laziness verdict.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“这轮要完成什么，哪项检查仍有用，何时需要重新确认？”给虚构任务写一个有限完成标准，不比较谁更勤奋，不把休息记成失败。观察的是具体安排，不能用一次清单修正来声称人格提升或分数应变高。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “What needs finishing now, which check remains useful, and what requires confirmation?” Set a bounded fictional completion criterion without ranking diligence or counting rest as failure. A changed checklist proves neither personality improvement nor a required score increase.

title.zh: 兴趣不等于展示出的能力

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构画展的一幅图可以按“雨中的街”直读，也可让读者想起一张折起来的地图。有人愿意说两种联想，却不喜欢抽象讨论；有人少作联想，但能提出实际的展签改法。联想多少、喜欢哪类材料与作品是否有用不是同一测量。读者偏好字面解释也可以，不把陌生、新颖或复杂本身排成更高级；本问卷没有评分他们的作品，也不能从一幅图反推出个人四个侧面数值。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented gallery image can be read literally as a rainy street or evoke a folded map. Someone offers both associations but dislikes abstract debate; another offers few associations yet suggests a useful caption revision. Associations, preferred material and usefulness are different observations. A literal reading is acceptable; unfamiliarity, novelty and complexity do not rank a response higher. The questionnaire scores no artwork and cannot infer personal facet values from one image.

title.zh: 尝试一次小而可逆的探索

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“哪条细节引出了这个读法，还能有另一种说明吗？”用编造图像描述或自己画草图，不买材料、不展示私梦，也不让他人按新奇程度评智力或创造力。熟悉方法、保留未知和结束讨论同样可选。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Which detail prompted that reading, and what other account is possible?” Describe or sketch an invented image without buying materials or disclosing dreams. Novelty measures neither intelligence nor creativity; familiar methods, unresolved questions and stopping remain options.
